**Job Description \- Production Planning**
**Job Title:** 
 Production Planner
   

  

**Location:** 
 (Sanand, Gujarat, India)
   

  

**About Us**
 Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Production Planner is responsible for developing, coordinating, and monitoring production schedules to ensure timely manufacturing and delivery of products balancing demand, inventory levels, and production efficiency. The role acts as a bridge between Sales, Procurement, Stores, and Production departments to ensure smooth production flow.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Create daily, weekly, and monthly production plans based on customer demand, sales forecasts, and inventory levels.
* Develop and maintain production schedules to meet delivery commitments.
* Balance production capacity and material availability.
* Monitor schedule adherence and take corrective actions to address delays.
* Review material availability and coordinate with Material Buyer for shortages.
* Track production performance against plan.
* Follow up on daily production status and report variances.
* Maintain production planning data in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle R12\).
* Generate and analyze planning reports, work orders, and production metrics.
* Ensure accuracy of BOMs, routing, lead times, and planning parameters.
* Coordinate with Sales, Material Buyer, Quality, Engineering and Logistics teams.
* Manage production priorities based on customer requirements.


**Requirements**
* Education: BE/B\-Tech Mechanical / Electrical
* 7\-10 Years of experience in Production Planning / Manufacturing Planning.


**Skills**
* Excellent communication and organizational skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Advanced Excel skills
* Knowledge of Capacity Planning and Inventory Management.
* Knowledge of ETO Planning and Execution
* Understanding of material requirements planning (MRP)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities
* Knowledge of ISO Standards and Energy management systems


**What We Offer**
* We are committed to helping you reach your professional, personal and financial goals. We offer competitive compensation that aligns with our business strategies and comprehensive benefits to help you live your healthiest. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse culture that engages as well as values the different backgrounds and experiences of our employee, which, in turn, spurs innovation, generates creative solutions and enhances our customer relations.

title: Analyst, Supply Chain Planning
description:
**About Analog Devices**
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 The Supply Chain team has an opening for a Supply Chain Analyst at our Gandhinagar office, India. This position reports to the Manager of Supply Chain. This role will be responsible for analyzing day\-to\-day supply chain issues and strategizing permanent improvement. This role will work closely with Supply chain analytics and system teams and will help drive continuous system improvement projects. The successful candidate must have good understanding of key supply chain functions, and hands\-on experience in analyzing complex issues \& must possess an understanding of supply chain operations.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Analyze supply chain key performance indicators and device actionable plans to resolve ongoing issues and identify permanent resolution steps
* Interface with senior management independently and provide regular performance updates
* Design, develop, and maintain advanced analytical models and dashboards
* Provide data driven insights that support scenario analysis, risk assessment, and strategic planning
* Define, measure, and report on supply chain Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that drive operational and strategic outcomes
* Identify process gaps cross functionally and provide insights to management for tactical or strategic improvements
* Work self\-directed and independently; and be a subject matter Expert
* Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to improve decision making and enhance end\-to\-end supply chain performance.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* BE/ME equivalent degree with 2 to 5 years of experience in supply chain analytics and production planning/capacity planning
* A flexible, pragmatic, and collaborative team player with innate ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Hands on knowledge of SQL / PLSQL
* Competency with data analysis and statistical tools, including Python or R
* Proficiency in dashboard development and data visualization (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, QlikView)
* Experience with Supply Chain Modeling and Planning Systems (e.g., Blue Yonder, Kinaxis)
* Experience working with MES/ERP systems, such as SAP

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: Intern (Operations Excellence)
description:
Job Title
 **Intern – Operations Excellence** 




 Department:
 **Operations Excellence** 




 Reporting To:
 **Head – Operations Excellence / Industrial Engineering** 




 Internship Duration:
 **6 Months** 




  





**Role Objective** 




 To support the Operations Excellence team in driving productivity improvement, mechanization, automation, layout optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations. The intern will gain hands\-on exposure to Industrial Engineering tools, Lean Manufacturing principles, and project execution while contributing to operational excellence projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Process Improvement \& Industrial Engineering
 


* Assist in conducting time studies, work studies, and motion studies.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing tools and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
* Assist in identifying and eliminating Non\-Value Added (NVA) activities.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Process improvement opportunities identified
* Improved process flow and standardized work practices



 2\. Mechanization \& Automation Projects
 


* Support execution of mechanization and automation projects across operations.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors during project implementation.
* Assist in machine trials, validation, documentation, and performance tracking.
* Monitor project timelines and maintain implementation trackers.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Timely project support
* Successful implementation tracking
* Automation project documentation



 3\. Layout Planning \& Workflow Optimization
 


* Assist in preparing and updating shop\-floor layouts using AutoCAD or equivalent software.
* Support workstation redesign to improve ergonomics and material flow.
* Participate in layout optimization activities for improved productivity and space utilization.
* Assist in material flow analysis and workstation balancing.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Optimized layouts
* Improved workflow and space utilization
* Reduced material movement



 4\. Productivity \& Capacity Improvement
 


* Collect and analyze production data.
* Prepare productivity reports and dashboards.
* Support capacity calculations and manpower utilization studies.
* Participate in bottleneck identification and capacity enhancement initiatives.



 Key Deliverables
 


* Productivity improvement reports
* Capacity analysis support
* Performance dashboards



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 



* Final Year or Pre\-final Year B.E./B.Tech or pursuing Master's in:
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Production Engineering
* Manufacturing Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Industrial \& Production Engineering



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Basic understanding of Lean Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering concepts
* Knowledge of Time Study, Motion Study, Line Balancing, and Process Mapping
* AutoCAD (preferred)
* Microsoft Excel \& PowerPoint
* Power BI (preferred)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work in a cross\-functional environment
* Proactive learning attitude



  





**Learning Outcomes** 




**During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:** 



* Industrial Engineering practices
* Manufacturing process optimization
* Mechanization and Automation projects
* Shop\-floor layout planning
* Lean Manufacturing implementation
* Continuous Improvement methodologies
* Project Management
* Cross\-functional stakeholder management
* Data analysis and reporting
* Manufacturing Operations Excellence

title: MIS Executive
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
 The MIS Executive will be responsible for managing and monitoring daily operational reports across Atlanta, Northcap, and Vivyx operations. The role involves ensuring data accuracy, tracking production and dispatch activities, and coordinating with teams to close open action points in a timely manner.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and maintain daily MIS reports for Atlanta, Northcap, and Vivyx operations
* Monitor daily production reports and ensure data accuracy and completeness
* Track daily issuance reports and highlight discrepancies if any
* Oversee daily dispatch and return reports for smooth operational flow
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure closure of pending/open points
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams for updates and issue resolution
* Ensure timely reporting and adherence to defined processes


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of MS Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis)
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong follow\-up and coordination abilities
* Attention to detail and accuracy in reporting
* Good communication skills


**Preferred Experience**
* 2–3 years of experience in MIS, reporting, or operations role
* Experience in handling multiple reports and data tracking


**Key Competencies**
* Time management and multitasking
* Accountability and ownership
* Process\-oriented approach
* Team collaboration

title: Senior Team Member
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Product Data Services or Security Master Team is responsible for setting up Fixed Income securities like Corporate Bonds, Municipal Bonds, Mortgage Back Securities, and Treasuries etc. on the back\-office systems to facilitate the trades to flow into various upstream and downstream systems across the Enterprise. Team also maintains the Fixed Income securities with updating the latest rates, factor, prices and ratings information to facilitate correct interest and principal calculations in the downstream accounting systems.
   

  

 Product Data Services process on legacy Merrill Lynch side does similar functions for Equity and equity related products like common stock, preferred, warrants, rights, equity options etc.
   

  

**Job Description**
 PDS/Security Master business provides associates a unique opportunity to learn and build hands on understanding of various asset classes ex; Fixed Income, Equities, Futures and Options traded globally. It provides the candidates a flavor of what attributes are required to build an instrument and ongoing amendments to facilitate various process across the bank to operate seamlessly. These instruments are required to be updated at various stages of the trade flow.
   

  

 The associates are expected to maintain good turnaround time and accuracy across all the set\-ups, rates and factor updates. Associates are expected to understand the security types and system capabilities to ensure smooth trade flow from front office to back office systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Setup and maintenance of Securities – Debt and Equity
* Use vendor databases – Bloomberg and IDSI to pull up security details for security set\-up or update.
* Setting up the Security per vendor database and responding to requestor within specified Turn Around Time
* Perform daily, weekly and monthly tasks on rates and factor updates for variable rate and factored bonds. Research on vendor databases for this information
* Perform self\-review of data input in the back\-office systems. Ensure secondary reviews for such data are performed by the assigned reviewer in the process
* Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills
* Must be quick learner to adapt to new systems and procedural change
* Ability to perform in a periodically changing process
* Comfortable to work in multiple systems at the same time
* Eye for detail and must be procedure focused to adhere to the Policy guidelines.
* Excellent organizational skills are required with the ability to prioritize workload, work accurately and efficiently under pressure.
* To be flexible in their attitude and approach; have a strong desire to learn from day to day scenarios.


**Requirements**
**Education** 
 – Graduate and Preferably MBA
   

  

* Certifications If Any – NCFM


**Experience Range** 
 – 2 to 4 years of experience for Senior Team Member
   

  

**Foundational Skills**
* Hands on understanding of Global Markets business and Product Data Services
* Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills
* Attention for detail and must be quick learner to adapt to new systems/procedural change


**Desired Skills**
* Hands on understanding of Process Controls
* Strong understanding of all asset classes
* Hands on understanding of MS Office applications


**Work Timings**
 16:30 to 01:30 IST, 18:30 to 03:30 IST, 20:30 to 05:30 IST \- Shift could vary in terms of business requirements and resourcing needs
   

  

**Job Location :** 
 Gandhinagar
